title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy arborio rice with mushrooms, white wine, and parmesan — a classic Milanese-style dish.
notes: Stir often and add the stock a ladle at a time — the rice should stay loose, not stiff. Finish with a knob of butter and a spoonful of crème fraîche.
steps: Sauté the mushrooms in butter until browned; don’t crowd the pan, then set them aside.
Cook the onion in butter until soft, then stir in the rice until it looks translucent at the edges.
Pour in the wine and stir until it has mostly evaporated — about 2 minutes.
Add the warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and letting each addition absorb before adding the next, for about 20 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms and parmesan, season, and serve at once.
